const localRunner = local.runner('local');
const diskSpace = H.command('disk-space-preflight').argv([
  'sh',
  '-c',
  'test "$(df --output=avail -BG / | tail -1 | tr -dc 0-9)" -ge 20',
]);
const hostA = ssh
  .host('host-a', { host: 'host-a.internal', user: 'ops', key: H.env('OPS_SSH_KEY') })
  .slots(1)
  .preflight(diskSpace);
const hostB = ssh
  .host('host-b', { host: 'host-b.internal', user: 'ops', key: H.env('OPS_SSH_KEY') })
  .slots(1)
  .preflight(diskSpace);
const backupHost = { orders: hostA, users: hostB };
const renewalHost = { 'example.com': hostA, 'shop.example.com': hostB };

const HeartbeatDue = H.state('heartbeat-due', 'pending');
const Healthy = H.terminal('healthy', 'success');
const Unhealthy = H.terminal('unhealthy', 'failure');

const BackupDue = H.state('backup-due', 'pending');
const BackedUp = H.terminal('backed-up', 'success');
const BackupFailed = H.terminal('backup-failed', 'failure');

const RenewalDue = H.state('renewal-due', 'pending');
const StillValid = H.terminal('still-valid', 'success');
const Renewed = H.terminal('renewed', 'success');
const RenewalFailed = H.terminal('renewal-failed', 'failure');

const IncidentOpen = H.state('incident-open', 'pending');
const Resolved = H.terminal('resolved', 'success');
const RunbookFailed = H.terminal('runbook-failed', 'failure');

const HeartbeatAttrs = z.object({ service: Service });
const BackupAttrs = z.object({ database: Database });
const RenewalAttrs = z.object({ domain: Domain });
const IncidentAttrs = z.object({ source: z.string(), subject: z.string(), detail: z.string() });

const Heartbeat = H.kind('Heartbeat')
  .attributes(HeartbeatAttrs)
  .states(HeartbeatDue, Healthy, Unhealthy)
  .key(attrs => attrs.service)
  .initial(HeartbeatDue);

const Backup = H.kind('Backup')
  .attributes(BackupAttrs)
  .states(BackupDue, BackedUp, BackupFailed)
  .key(attrs => attrs.database)
  .initial(BackupDue);

const CertificateRenewal = H.kind('CertificateRenewal')
  .attributes(RenewalAttrs)
  .states(RenewalDue, StillValid, Renewed, RenewalFailed)
  .key(attrs => attrs.domain)
  .initial(RenewalDue);

const Incident = H.kind('Incident')
  .attributes(IncidentAttrs)
  .states(IncidentOpen, Resolved, RunbookFailed)
  .key(attrs => `${attrs.source}:${attrs.subject}`)
  .initial(IncidentOpen);

const probe = H.command('heartbeat-probe')
  .input(HeartbeatAttrs)
  .argv(input => ['./ops/heartbeat.sh', input.service])
  .runner(localRunner);

const dump = H.command('database-backup')
  .input(BackupAttrs)
  .argv(input => ['./ops/backup.sh', input.database])
  .runner(input => backupHost[input.database]);

const certificateCheck = H.command('certificate-days-left')
  .input(RenewalAttrs)
  .argv(input => ['./ops/cert-days-left.sh', input.domain])
  .output(z.object({ daysLeft: z.number() }))
  .runner(input => renewalHost[input.domain]);

const certificateRenew = H.command('certificate-renew')
  .input(RenewalAttrs)
  .argv(input => ['./ops/cert-renew.sh', input.domain])
  .runner(input => renewalHost[input.domain]);

const pageOnCall = H.command('page-on-call')
  .input(IncidentAttrs)
  .argv(input => ['./ops/page.sh', input.subject, input.detail])
  .runner(localRunner);

const runbook = H.command('runbook')
  .input(IncidentAttrs)
  .argv(input => ['./runbooks/run.sh', input.source, input.subject])
  .runner(localRunner);

const acknowledge = H.halt('acknowledge').decision(z.object({ acknowledgedBy: z.string() }));
const confirmResolution = H.halt('confirm-resolution').decision(
  z.object({ resolved: z.boolean(), note: z.string() }),
);

const heartbeatFlow = H.flow('heartbeat')
  .input(HeartbeatAttrs)
  .step('probe', probe, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes)
  .exit('healthy');

const backupFlow = H.flow('backup')
  .input(BackupAttrs)
  .step('dump', dump, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes, { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .exit('backedUp');

const renewalFlow = H.flow('certificate-renewal')
  .input(RenewalAttrs)
  .step('check', certificateCheck, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes)
  .exit('stillValid', ctx => ctx.steps.check.daysLeft >= 14)
  .step('renew', certificateRenew, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes)
  .exit('renewed');

const incidentFlow = H.flow('incident-runbook')
  .input(IncidentAttrs)
  .step('page', pageOnCall, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes)
  .halt('acknowledge', acknowledge, {
    ask: ctx => `Acknowledge incident ${ctx.unit.attributes.subject}: ${ctx.unit.attributes.detail}`,
  })
  .step('runbook', runbook, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes, { afterCrash: 'park' })
  .halt('confirm', confirmResolution, {
    ask: ctx => `Runbook finished for ${ctx.unit.attributes.subject}. Is the incident resolved?`,
  })
  .exit('resolved', ctx => ctx.steps.confirm.resolved)
  .exit('reopened');

const heartbeats = H.lane('heartbeats', Heartbeat)
  .supply(H.clock('every-five-minutes').every({ minutes: 5 }), (_tick, to) =>
    Service.options.map(name => to.create({ service: name })),
  )
  .handler(heartbeatFlow, { exits: { healthy: Healthy } })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 1, exhausted: Unhealthy });

const backups = H.lane('backups', Backup)
  .supply(H.clock('nightly-0100').at('01:00', { tz: 'UTC' }), (_tick, to) =>
    Database.options.map(database => to.create({ database })),
  )
  .handler(backupFlow, { exits: { backedUp: BackedUp } })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 1, exhausted: BackupFailed });

const renewals = H.lane('certificate-renewals', CertificateRenewal)
  .supply(H.clock('weekly-sunday-0300').at('03:00', { on: 'sun', tz: 'UTC' }), (_tick, to) =>
    Domain.options.map(domain => to.create({ domain })),
  )
  .handler(renewalFlow, { exits: { stillValid: StillValid, renewed: Renewed } })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 3, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 900_000, exhausted: RenewalFailed });

const incidents = H.lane('incidents', Incident)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .handler(incidentFlow, { exits: { resolved: Resolved, reopened: IncidentOpen } })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 3, backoff: 'fixed', initialDelayMs: 60_000, exhausted: RunbookFailed });

const operationalExperience = H.journal('operational-experience', H.memory('operational', 'experience'))
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '.harness/operational.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 20 });

const threeFailedHeartbeatsOpenIncident = H.trigger('three-failed-heartbeats-open-incident')
  .on(
    H.when.pattern(heartbeats, {
      to: Unhealthy,
      consecutive: 3,
      per: unit => service.of(unit.attributes.service),
    }),
  )
  .create(incidents, event => ({
    source: 'heartbeat',
    subject: event.group.value,
    detail: `${event.streak} consecutive failed heartbeats for ${event.group.value}`,
  }));

const failedBackupOpensIncident = H.trigger('failed-backup-opens-incident')
  .on(H.when.transition(backups, { to: BackupFailed }))
  .create(incidents, event => ({
    source: 'backup',
    subject: event.unit.attributes.database,
    detail: `Backup of ${event.unit.attributes.database} failed at ${event.at.toISOString()}`,
  }));

const slowBackupIsNoted = H.trigger('slow-backup-is-noted')
  .on(
    H.when.transition(backups, {
      to: BackedUp,
      if: event => (event.attempt?.durationMs ?? 0) > 2 * 3_600_000,
    }),
  )
  .record(operationalExperience, event => ({
    text: `When scheduling the ${event.unit.attributes.database} backup, allow more than two hours, because the run finishing ${event.at.toISOString()} took ${((event.attempt?.durationMs ?? 0) / 3_600_000).toFixed(1)} hours`,
    when: { kinds: [Backup], resources: [databases[event.unit.attributes.database]] },
    status: 'active',
  }));

const scheduler = H.scheduler('operations')
  .expedite(incidents, { holds: [backups] })
  .standard(heartbeats, backups, renewals);

const controlApi = http.controlApi('ops-control', {
  port: H.slot.port(0),
  token: H.env('OPS_CONTROL_TOKEN'),
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.workCreate,
    H.ops.resolve(acknowledge, confirmResolution),
    H.ops.attemptsRecover,
    H.ops.memoryRead,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

export default H.harness('operations')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '/var/lib/harness/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(incidents, heartbeats, backups, renewals)
  .journals(operationalExperience)
  .triggers(threeFailedHeartbeatsOpenIncident, failedBackupOpensIncident, slowBackupIsNoted)
  .scheduler(scheduler)
  .clients(controlApi)
  .observers(
    slack.notifier('incident-channel', { webhookUrl: H.env('SLACK_INCIDENT_WEBHOOK'), lanes: [incidents] }),
    markdown.board({ path: '/var/lib/harness/BOARD.md' }),
  );

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H, Retry } from 'harness-dsl';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { jsonl } from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { ssh } from 'harness-dsl/ssh';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const SourceSystem = z.enum(['crm', 'billing', 'inventory', 'events']);
const LoadAttrs = z.object({ source: SourceSystem, night: z.string() });

const Scheduled = H.state('scheduled', 'pending');
const Loaded = H.terminal('loaded', 'success');
const LoadedWithWarnings = H.terminal('loaded-with-warnings', 'success');
const Rejected = H.terminal('rejected', 'failure');
const Failed = H.terminal('failed', 'failure');
const Expired = H.terminal('approval-expired', 'failure');

const NightlyLoad = H.kind('NightlyLoad')
  .attributes(LoadAttrs)
  .states(Scheduled, Loaded, LoadedWithWarnings, Rejected, Failed, Expired)
  .key(attrs => `${attrs.source}:${attrs.night}`)
  .initial(Scheduled);

const approvalExpired = H.signal('approval-expired');

const etlHost = ssh.host('etl-host', { host: 'etl.internal', user: 'etl', key: H.env('ETL_SSH_KEY') });

const extract = H.command('extract')
  .input(LoadAttrs)
  .argv(input => ['./etl/extract', input.source, input.night])
  .runner(etlHost);

const validate = H.command('validate')
  .input(LoadAttrs)
  .argv(input => ['./etl/validate', input.source, input.night])
  .acceptExitCodes(0, 1)
  .output(z.object({ passed: z.boolean(), report: z.string(), anomalies: z.array(z.string()) }))
  .runner(etlHost);

const load = H.command('load')
  .input(LoadAttrs)
  .argv(input => ['./etl/load', input.source, input.night])
  .runner(etlHost);

const verify = H.command('verify')
  .input(LoadAttrs)
  .argv(input => ['./etl/verify', input.source, input.night])
  .acceptExitCodes(0, 2)
  .output(z.object({ driftRows: z.number() }))
  .runner(etlHost);

const quota = sqlite.quota('etl-quota', { path: '.harness/quota.sqlite' });
const apiAccount = anthropic.account('etl-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'), quota });
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });
const apiPool = H.pool('etl-api').accounts(apiAccount);

const summarizerRole = H.role('anomaly-summarizer')
  .intents('read')
  .instructions('Summarise validation anomalies in plain language for the approver.');
const approverRole = H.role('approver')
  .intents('read', 'record')
  .instructions('Approve or reject the nightly load.');

const summarizer = H.seat('anomaly-summarizer')
  .role(summarizerRole)
  .model(sonnet)
  .pool(apiPool)
  .output(z.object({ summary: z.string() }));

const validationReview = H.halt('validation-review').decision(z.object({ proceed: z.boolean(), note: z.string() }));
const loadApproval = H.halt('load-approval').decision(
  z.object({ approved: z.boolean(), note: z.string().optional() }),
);

const transientRetry: Retry = { maxAttempts: 3, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 60_000 };

const nightlyLoadFlow = H.flow('nightly-load')
  .input(LoadAttrs)
  .step('extract', extract, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes, { retry: transientRetry, afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .step('validate', validate, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes, { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .halt('validationReview', validationReview, {
    when: ctx => !ctx.steps.validate.passed,
    ask: ctx => `Validation failed for ${ctx.unit.attributes.source} on ${ctx.unit.attributes.night}:\n\n${ctx.steps.validate.report}`,
  })
  .exit('invalid', ctx => ctx.steps.validationReview?.proceed === false)
  .step('summarize', summarizer, ctx => ({
    task: `Summarise these anomalies for the approver:\n- ${ctx.steps.validate.anomalies.join('\n- ')}`,
  }))
  .halt('approval', loadApproval, {
    ask: ctx => `Approve the ${ctx.unit.attributes.source} load for ${ctx.unit.attributes.night}?\n\n${ctx.steps.summarize.summary}`,
  })
  .exit('rejected', ctx => !ctx.steps.approval.approved)
  .step('load', load, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes, { retry: transientRetry, afterCrash: 'park' })
  .step('verify', verify, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes, { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .exit('loaded', ctx => ctx.steps.verify.driftRows === 0)
  .exit('loadedWithWarnings');

const loads = H.lane('nightly-loads', NightlyLoad)
  .supply(H.clock('nightly-0200').at('02:00', { tz: 'Europe/Berlin' }), (tick, to) =>
    SourceSystem.options.map(source => to.create({ source, night: tick.at.toISOString().slice(0, 10) })),
  )
  .handler(nightlyLoadFlow, {
    exits: { invalid: Rejected, rejected: Rejected, loaded: Loaded, loadedWithWarnings: LoadedWithWarnings },
  })
  .store(sqlite.store({ path: '.harness/loads.sqlite' }))
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 1, exhausted: Failed })
  .on(approvalExpired, { enter: Expired, at: ['approval'] });

const approvalWindowCloses = H.trigger('approval-window-closes-at-0900')
  .on(
    H.when.timer(loads, {
      at: unit =>
        unit.position === 'terminal'
          ? undefined
          : H.nextTime('09:00', { after: unit.createdAt, tz: 'Europe/Berlin' }),
    }),
  )
  .signal(approvalExpired, loads, event => ({ key: event.unit.key, payload: {} }));

const approverTaste = H.journal('approver-taste', H.memory('approver-taste', 'taste'))
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '.harness/approver-taste.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 10 })
  .readBy(summarizerRole)
  .recordedBy(approverRole);

const scheduler = H.scheduler('nightly').standard(loads);

const supervisor = claudeCode.supervisor('approver-supervisor', {
  port: H.slot.port(0),
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.resolve(validationReview, loadApproval),
    H.ops.attemptsRecover,
    H.ops.memoryRead,
    H.ops.memoryWrite,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

export default H.harness('nightly-data')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '.harness/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(loads)
  .journals(approverTaste)
  .triggers(approvalWindowCloses)
  .scheduler(scheduler)
  .clients(supervisor)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: 'BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: 'TELEMETRY.md' }));

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H, MetricRef, Resource } from 'harness-dsl';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { jsonl } from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { contentful } from 'harness-dsl/contentful';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const Section = z.enum(['news', 'sports', 'opinion']);
type Section = z.infer<typeof Section>;

const sections: Record<Section, Resource> = {
  news: H.resource('news'),
  sports: H.resource('sports'),
  opinion: H.resource('opinion'),
};

const DraftAttrs = z.object({ entryId: z.string(), title: z.string(), section: Section, body: z.string() });
type DraftAttrs = z.infer<typeof DraftAttrs>;

const Submitted = H.state('submitted', 'pending');
const Accepted = H.terminal('accepted', 'success');
const Returned = H.terminal('returned', 'neutral');
const ReviewFailed = H.terminal('review-failed', 'failure');

const Draft = H.kind('Draft')
  .attributes(DraftAttrs)
  .states(Submitted, Accepted, Returned, ReviewFailed)
  .key(attrs => attrs.entryId)
  .initial(Submitted);

const quota = sqlite.quota('newsroom-quota', { path: '.harness/quota.sqlite' });
const apiAccount = anthropic.account('newsroom-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'), quota });
const opus = anthropic.model('opus', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' });
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });
const haiku = anthropic.model('haiku', { id: 'claude-haiku-4-5' });
const apiPool = H.pool('newsroom-api').accounts(apiAccount);

const reviewerRole = H.role('reviewer')
  .intents('read')
  .instructions('Critique the draft against the house taste and the facts.');
const editorRole = H.role('editor')
  .intents('read', 'record')
  .instructions('Accept or return drafts; curate taste.');

const reviewerCandidates = [opus, sonnet, haiku];

const editorActedOnComparison = H.policy.model('editor-acted-on-comparison', reviewerCandidates, ctx => {
  const taken = ctx.assigned.map(assignment => assignment.model);
  const free = reviewerCandidates.filter(model => !taken.includes(model));
  const current = ctx.current;
  if (current === undefined || taken.includes(current)) return free[0] ?? opus;
  const own = ctx.metrics.rate(actedOn, { seat: ctx.seat, model: current, window: { lastDays: 90 } });
  if (own.samples < 50) return current;
  const weaker = ctx.peers.some(peer => {
    const rival = ctx.metrics.rate(actedOn, { seat: peer, window: { lastDays: 90 } });
    return rival.samples >= 50 && rival.rate > own.rate;
  });
  if (!weaker) return current;
  return free.find(model => model !== current) ?? current;
});

const Critique = z.object({ critique: z.string() });

const reviewerA = H.seat('reviewer-a')
  .role(reviewerRole)
  .model(editorActedOnComparison)
  .pool(apiPool)
  .output(Critique);

const reviewerB = H.seat('reviewer-b')
  .role(reviewerRole)
  .model(editorActedOnComparison)
  .pool(apiPool)
  .output(Critique);

const localRunner = local.runner('local');

const factCheck = H.command('fact-check')
  .input(z.object({ body: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['./tools/fact-check', input.body])
  .output(z.object({ repeatMistake: z.string().optional() }))
  .runner(localRunner);

const mergeCritiques = H.command('merge-critiques')
  .input(z.object({ a: z.string(), b: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['./tools/merge-critiques', input.a, input.b])
  .output(z.object({ merged: z.string() }))
  .runner(localRunner);

const editorial = H.halt('editorial').decision(
  z.object({
    action: z.enum(['accept', 'return']),
    notes: z.string(),
    actedOn: z.enum(['a', 'b', 'both', 'neither']),
  }),
);

const critiqueTask = (draft: DraftAttrs) => ({
  task: `Critique the ${draft.section} draft "${draft.title}":\n\n${draft.body}`,
  resources: [sections[draft.section]],
});

const reviewFlow = H.flow('review')
  .input(DraftAttrs)
  .step('critiqueA', reviewerA, ctx => critiqueTask(ctx.unit.attributes))
  .step('critiqueB', reviewerB, ctx => critiqueTask(ctx.unit.attributes))
  .step('factCheck', factCheck, ctx => ({ body: ctx.unit.attributes.body }))
  .step('merge', mergeCritiques, ctx => ({ a: ctx.steps.critiqueA.critique, b: ctx.steps.critiqueB.critique }))
  .halt('editorial', editorial, {
    ask: ctx => `Accept or return "${ctx.unit.attributes.title}"?\n\n${ctx.steps.merge.merged}`,
  })
  .exit('accepted', ctx => ctx.steps.editorial.action === 'accept')
  .exit('returned');

const contentStore = { space: 'newsroom', token: H.env('CONTENTFUL_TOKEN') };

const drafts = H.lane('drafts', Draft)
  .supply(contentful.drafts({ ...contentStore, everyMinutes: 10 }), (entry, to) => {
    const section = Section.safeParse(entry.section);
    return section.success
      ? to.create({ entryId: entry.id, title: entry.title, section: section.data, body: entry.body })
      : to.skip();
  })
  .handler(reviewFlow, { exits: { accepted: Accepted, returned: Returned } })
  .store(contentful.store(contentStore))
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 300_000, exhausted: ReviewFailed });

const actedOn: MetricRef<'rate'> = H.metric('critique-acted-on', H.when.decision(Draft, editorial)).samples(event => [
  {
    hit: event.decision.actedOn === 'a' || event.decision.actedOn === 'both',
    seat: reviewerA,
    model: event.modelFor(reviewerA),
  },
  {
    hit: event.decision.actedOn === 'b' || event.decision.actedOn === 'both',
    seat: reviewerB,
    model: event.modelFor(reviewerB),
  },
]);

const editorTaste = H.journal('editor-taste', H.memory('editor-taste', 'taste'))
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '.harness/taste.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 20 })
  .readBy(reviewerRole)
  .recordedBy(editorRole);

const factChecking = H.journal('fact-checking', H.memory('fact-checking', 'experience'))
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '.harness/fact-checking.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 10 })
  .readBy(reviewerRole);

const returnedNotesBecomeTasteCandidates = H.trigger('returned-notes-become-taste-candidates')
  .on(H.when.decision(Draft, editorial))
  .record(editorTaste, event =>
    event.decision.action === 'return'
      ? {
          text: event.decision.notes,
          when: { roles: [reviewerRole], resources: [sections[event.unit.attributes.section]] },
          status: 'candidate',
        }
      : undefined,
  );

const repeatMistakesBecomeExperience = H.trigger('repeat-mistakes-become-experience')
  .on(H.when.step(drafts, 'factCheck'))
  .record(factChecking, event => {
    const mistake = event.output?.repeatMistake;
    return mistake === undefined ? undefined : { text: mistake, when: { roles: [reviewerRole] }, status: 'active' };
  });

const scheduler = H.scheduler('newsroom').standard(drafts);

const editorSupervisor = claudeCode.supervisor('editor-supervisor', {
  port: H.slot.port(0),
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.resolve(editorial),
    H.ops.memoryRead,
    H.ops.memoryWrite,
    H.ops.memoryCurate,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

export default H.harness('content-review')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '.harness/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(drafts)
  .journals(editorTaste, factChecking)
  .triggers(returnedNotesBecomeTasteCandidates, repeatMistakesBecomeExperience)
  .metrics(actedOn)
  .scheduler(scheduler)
  .clients(editorSupervisor)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: 'BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: 'TELEMETRY.md' }));

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H, Account } from 'harness-dsl';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { jsonl } from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { linear } from 'harness-dsl/linear';
import { folder } from 'harness-dsl/folder';
import { git } from 'harness-dsl/git';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

export const sharedQuota = sqlite.quota('claude-subscriptions', { path: '/var/lib/harness/shared-quota.sqlite' });

export const max1 = claudeCode.subscription('max-1', { token: H.env('CLAUDE_MAX_1_TOKEN'), quota: sharedQuota });
export const max2 = claudeCode.subscription('max-2', { token: H.env('CLAUDE_MAX_2_TOKEN'), quota: sharedQuota });
export const max3 = claudeCode.subscription('max-3', { token: H.env('CLAUDE_MAX_3_TOKEN'), quota: sharedQuota });
export const subscriptions: readonly Account[] = [max1, max2, max3];

export const sonnet = claudeCode.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });
export const opus = claudeCode.model('opus', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' });

export const soonestExpiring = H.policy.account('soonest-expiring', ctx =>
  [...ctx.candidates]
    .filter(a => a.shareUsed < a.shareCap && (a.cooldownUntil === undefined || a.cooldownUntil <= ctx.now))
    .sort((a, b) => a.windowResetsAt.getTime() - b.windowResetsAt.getTime())[0],
);

export function sharedPool(name: string, shareOfEachWindow: number) {
  return subscriptions.reduce(
    (pool, account) => pool.share(account, shareOfEachWindow),
    H.pool(name).accounts(...subscriptions).drain(soonestExpiring),
  );
}

export const builderRole = H.role('builder').intents('read', 'edit', 'run', 'halt').instructions('Implement the task in the worktree. Stop only when the checks pass.');
export const plannerRole = H.role('planner').intents('read', 'search').instructions('Decompose the epic into independently shippable features.');
export const auditorRole = H.role('auditor').intents('read', 'run', 'record').instructions('List every deficit against the task. Record lessons worth keeping.');
export const writerRole = H.role('writer').intents('read', 'edit').instructions('Revise the documentation page for accuracy and clarity.');

export const ownerTaste = H.memory('owner-taste', 'taste');
export const experience = H.memory('experience', 'experience');

export const tasteJournal = H.journal('owner-taste', ownerTaste)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '/var/lib/harness/owner-taste.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 12 })
  .readBy(builderRole, plannerRole, writerRole);

const WorkItem = z.object({ ticket: z.string().optional(), title: z.string(), description: z.string() });
const EpicAttrs = z.object({ ticket: z.string(), title: z.string(), description: z.string() });
const HeartbeatAttrs = z.object({ service: z.string() });
const Deficits = z.object({ deficits: z.array(z.string()) });
const FeaturePlan = z.object({ features: z.array(z.object({ title: z.string(), description: z.string() })) });

const Todo = H.state('Todo', 'pending');
const Done = H.terminal('Done', 'success');
const Unresolved = H.terminal('Unresolved', 'failure');
const WontDo = H.terminal('WontDo', 'neutral');

const EpicOpen = H.state('EpicOpen', 'pending');
const EpicDelivered = H.terminal('EpicDelivered', 'success');
const EpicAbandoned = H.terminal('EpicAbandoned', 'failure');

const HeartbeatDue = H.state('HeartbeatDue', 'pending');
const Healthy = H.terminal('Healthy', 'success');
const Unhealthy = H.terminal('Unhealthy', 'failure');

const Bug = H.kind('Bug').attributes(WorkItem).states(Todo, Done, Unresolved, WontDo).key(a => a.ticket ?? a.title).initial(Todo);
const Feature = H.kind('Feature').attributes(WorkItem).states(Todo, Done, Unresolved, WontDo).key(a => a.ticket ?? a.title).initial(Todo);
const Epic = H.kind('Epic').attributes(EpicAttrs).states(EpicOpen, EpicDelivered, EpicAbandoned).key(a => a.ticket).initial(EpicOpen);
const Heartbeat = H.kind('Heartbeat').attributes(HeartbeatAttrs).states(HeartbeatDue, Healthy, Unhealthy).key(a => a.service).initial(HeartbeatDue);

const ownerDecision = H.halt('owner-decision').decision(z.object({ choice: z.string(), note: z.string() }));

const apiAccount = anthropic.account('project-a-api', {
  apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'),
  quota: sqlite.quota('project-a-api', { path: './project-a/api-quota.sqlite' }),
});

const poolA = sharedPool('project-a-subscriptions', 0.6).fallback(apiAccount);

const builderModel = H.policy.model('builder-model', [sonnet, opus], ctx => {
  const cheap = ctx.metrics.attempts({ of: ctx.kind, seat: ctx.seat, model: sonnet, window: { lastDays: 14 } });
  return cheap.samples >= 20 && cheap.successRate < 0.85 ? opus : sonnet;
});

const projectChecks = H.command('project-checks').argv(['npm', 'run', 'check']);
const worktree = git.worktree('project-a-worktree', { repo: '.', base: 'main' }).leaseFiles().exitCheck(projectChecks);

const builder = H.seat('builder').role(builderRole).model(builderModel).pool(poolA).runner(worktree).halts(ownerDecision);
const auditor = H.seat('auditor').role(auditorRole).model(opus).pool(poolA).runner(worktree).output(Deficits);
const planner = H.seat('planner').role(plannerRole).model(opus).pool(poolA).output(FeaturePlan);

const experienceA = H.journal('project-a-experience', experience)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: './project-a/experience.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 8 })
  .readBy(builderRole, auditorRole)
  .recordedBy(auditorRole);

const buildAndAudit = H.flow('build-and-audit')
  .input(WorkItem)
  .params(z.object({ rounds: z.number() }))
  .loop('rounds', Deficits, f => f
    .step('build', builder, ctx => ({
      task: `${ctx.unit.attributes.title}\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.description}\n\nDeficits from earlier rounds:\n${ctx.steps.rounds.flatMap(r => r.deficits).join('\n')}`,
    }))
    .step('audit', auditor, ctx => ({ task: `Audit the change for: ${ctx.unit.attributes.title}\n\nBuilder report:\n${ctx.steps.build}` })),
    {
      max: ctx => ctx.params.rounds,
      until: ctx => ctx.steps.audit.deficits.length === 0,
      keep: ctx => ctx.steps.audit,
    })
  .exit('done', ctx => ctx.steps.audit.deficits.length === 0)
  .exit('outOfRounds');

const trackerKey = H.env('LINEAR_API_KEY');
const tracker = linear.store({ apiKey: trackerKey, team: 'PROD', workflow: ['Todo', 'In Progress', 'Done', 'Canceled'] });

const bugLane = H.lane('bugs', Bug)
  .supply(linear.issues({ apiKey: trackerKey, team: 'PROD', labels: ['bug'] }), (issue, to) =>
    to.create({ ticket: issue.identifier, title: issue.title, description: issue.description }))
  .supply(folder.files({ path: './bugs', glob: '*.md' }), (file, to) => to.create({ title: file.name, description: file.body }))
  .supply(H.operator)
  .handler(buildAndAudit, { exits: { done: Done, outOfRounds: Unresolved }, params: { rounds: 3 } })
  .store(tracker, { states: { Todo: 'Todo', Done: 'Done', Unresolved: 'Canceled', WontDo: 'Canceled' }, inFlight: 'In Progress' })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 60_000, exhausted: Unresolved })
  .on(H.cancel, { enter: WontDo });

const featureLane = H.lane('features', Feature)
  .supply(linear.issues({ apiKey: trackerKey, team: 'PROD', labels: ['feature'] }), (issue, to) =>
    to.create({ ticket: issue.identifier, title: issue.title, description: issue.description }))
  .supply(H.operator)
  .handler(buildAndAudit, { exits: { done: Done, outOfRounds: Unresolved }, params: { rounds: 5 } })
  .store(tracker, { states: { Todo: 'Todo', Done: 'Done', Unresolved: 'Canceled', WontDo: 'Canceled' }, inFlight: 'In Progress' })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 60_000, exhausted: Unresolved })
  .on(H.cancel, { enter: WontDo });

const epicFlow = H.flow('epic')
  .input(EpicAttrs)
  .step('plan', planner, ctx => ({ task: `Decompose epic ${ctx.unit.attributes.title}:\n${ctx.unit.attributes.description}` }))
  .spawn('features', featureLane, ctx => ctx.steps.plan.features.map(f => ({ title: f.title, description: f.description })))
  .exit('delivered', ctx => ctx.steps.features.every(c => c.verdict === 'success'))
  .exit('abandoned');

const epicLane = H.lane('epics', Epic)
  .supply(linear.issues({ apiKey: trackerKey, team: 'PROD', labels: ['epic'] }), (issue, to) =>
    to.create({ ticket: issue.identifier, title: issue.title, description: issue.description }))
  .handler(epicFlow, { exits: { delivered: EpicDelivered, abandoned: EpicAbandoned } })
  .store(tracker, { states: { EpicOpen: 'Todo', EpicDelivered: 'Done', EpicAbandoned: 'Canceled' }, inFlight: 'In Progress' })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, exhausted: EpicAbandoned });

const localRunner = local.runner('project-a-local');
const probe = H.command('service-probe')
  .input(HeartbeatAttrs)
  .argv(i => ['./scripts/probe.sh', i.service])
  .runner(localRunner);

const heartbeatFlow = H.flow('heartbeat')
  .input(HeartbeatAttrs)
  .step('probe', probe, ctx => ({ service: ctx.unit.attributes.service }))
  .exit('healthy');

const heartbeatLane = H.lane('heartbeats', Heartbeat)
  .supply(H.clock('every-five-minutes').every({ minutes: 5 }), (_tick, to) => ['api', 'worker'].map(service => to.create({ service })))
  .handler(heartbeatFlow, { exits: { healthy: Healthy } })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 1, exhausted: Unhealthy });

const heartbeatFailureFilesBug = H.trigger('heartbeat-failure-files-bug')
  .on(H.when.transition(heartbeatLane, { to: Unhealthy }))
  .create(bugLane, ev => ({
    title: `Heartbeat failed: ${ev.unit.attributes.service}`,
    description: `The ${ev.unit.attributes.service} heartbeat failed at ${ev.at.toISOString()}.`,
  }));

const productionProbe = H.operation('production-health-probe', H.command('production-probe').argv(['./scripts/prod-health.sh']).runner(localRunner));

const supervisorA = claudeCode.supervisor('project-a-supervisor', {
  port: H.slot.port(1),
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead, H.ops.workCreate, H.ops.workUpdate, H.ops.workCancel,
    H.ops.resolve(ownerDecision), H.ops.memoryWrite, H.ops.telemetryRead,
    H.ops.accountsRead, H.ops.accountsShare, productionProbe,
  ],
});

export const harnessA = H.harness('project-a')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: './project-a/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(heartbeatLane, bugLane, featureLane, epicLane)
  .journals(tasteJournal, experienceA)
  .triggers(heartbeatFailureFilesBug)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('project-a')
    .expedite(heartbeatLane)
    .standard(bugLane, featureLane, epicLane)
    .wip(bugLane, 2)
    .wip(epicLane, 1)
    .aging(featureLane, { afterMinutes: 240 }))
  .clients(supervisorA)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: './project-a/BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: './project-a/TELEMETRY.md' }));

const DocPageAttrs = z.object({ path: z.string(), title: z.string(), body: z.string() });
const DocQueued = H.state('DocQueued', 'pending');
const Published = H.terminal('Published', 'success');
const Broken = H.terminal('Broken', 'failure');
const DocPage = H.kind('DocPage').attributes(DocPageAttrs).states(DocQueued, Published, Broken).key(a => a.path).initial(DocQueued);

const poolB = sharedPool('project-b-subscriptions', 0.3);
const docsWorktree = git.worktree('docs-worktree', { repo: '../docs', base: 'main' });
const writer = H.seat('writer').role(writerRole).model(sonnet).pool(poolB).runner(docsWorktree);
const linkCheck = H.command('link-check').input(z.object({ path: z.string() })).argv(i => ['npx', 'linkinator', i.path]).runner(docsWorktree);

const experienceB = H.journal('project-b-experience', experience)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: '../docs/.harness/experience.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 8 })
  .readBy(writerRole)
  .recordedBy(writerRole);

const docFlow = H.flow('write-doc')
  .input(DocPageAttrs)
  .step('write', writer, ctx => ({ task: `Revise ${ctx.unit.attributes.path} (${ctx.unit.attributes.title}).` }))
  .step('linkCheck', linkCheck, ctx => ({ path: ctx.unit.attributes.path }))
  .exit('published');

const docLane = H.lane('docs', DocPage)
  .supply(folder.files({ path: '../docs/pages', glob: '**/*.md' }), (file, to) => to.create({ path: file.path, title: file.name, body: file.body }))
  .handler(docFlow, { exits: { published: Published } })
  .store(folder.frontmatter({ path: '../docs/pages' }))
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, exhausted: Broken });

const supervisorB = claudeCode.supervisor('project-b-supervisor', {
  port: H.slot.port(2),
  grants: [H.ops.workRead, H.ops.workCreate, H.ops.memoryWrite, H.ops.telemetryRead, H.ops.accountsRead, H.ops.accountsShare],
});

export const harnessB = H.harness('project-b')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '../docs/.harness/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(docLane)
  .journals(tasteJournal, experienceB)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('project-b').standard(docLane))
  .clients(supervisorB)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: '../docs/.harness/BOARD.md' }));

export const ownerSession = claudeCode.session('owner', { endpoints: [supervisorA, supervisorB] });

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { webhook } from 'harness-dsl/webhook';
import { http } from 'harness-dsl/http';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const store = sqlite.store({ path: './lifecycles/store.sqlite' });
const runner = local.runner('local');

const apiAccount = anthropic.account('api', {
  apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'),
  quota: sqlite.quota('lifecycles-api', { path: './lifecycles/quota.sqlite' }),
});
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });
const pool = H.pool('main').accounts(apiAccount);

const ExperimentAttrs = z.object({ experiment: z.string() });
const ExperimentScheduled = H.state('ExperimentScheduled', 'pending');
const AWins = H.terminal('AWins', 'neutral');
const BWins = H.terminal('BWins', 'neutral');
const Inconclusive = H.terminal('Inconclusive', 'neutral');
const MeasurementFailed = H.terminal('MeasurementFailed', 'failure');
const Experiment = H.kind('Experiment')
  .attributes(ExperimentAttrs)
  .states(ExperimentScheduled, AWins, BWins, Inconclusive, MeasurementFailed)
  .key(a => a.experiment)
  .initial(ExperimentScheduled);

const measure = H.command('measure-experiment')
  .input(ExperimentAttrs)
  .argv(i => ['./bin/measure', i.experiment])
  .runner(runner);
const decideWinner = H.command('decide-experiment')
  .input(ExperimentAttrs)
  .argv(i => ['./bin/decide', i.experiment])
  .output(z.object({ winner: z.enum(['A', 'B', 'none']) }))
  .runner(runner);

const experimentFlow = H.flow('experiment')
  .input(ExperimentAttrs)
  .loop('hours', f => f
    .step('measure', measure, ctx => ({ experiment: ctx.unit.attributes.experiment }), {
      retry: { maxAttempts: 3, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 60_000 },
      afterCrash: 'rerun',
    })
    .wait('nextHour', { ms: 3_600_000 }),
    { max: 14 * 24 })
  .step('decide', decideWinner, ctx => ({ experiment: ctx.unit.attributes.experiment }))
  .exit('aWins', ctx => ctx.steps.decide.winner === 'A')
  .exit('bWins', ctx => ctx.steps.decide.winner === 'B')
  .exit('inconclusive');

const experimentLane = H.lane('experiments', Experiment)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .handler(experimentFlow, { exits: { aWins: AWins, bWins: BWins, inconclusive: Inconclusive } })
  .store(store)
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, exhausted: MeasurementFailed });

const TenancyAttrs = z.object({ customerId: z.string(), plan: z.string() });
const ReviewDue = H.state('ReviewDue', 'pending');
const Customer = H.state('Customer', 'waiting');
const Suspended = H.state('Suspended', 'waiting');
const Churned = H.terminal('Churned', 'neutral');
const Tenancy = H.kind('Tenancy')
  .attributes(TenancyAttrs)
  .states(ReviewDue, Customer, Suspended, Churned)
  .key(a => a.customerId)
  .initial(ReviewDue);

const reviewDue = H.signal('review-due');
const suspend = H.signal('suspend');
const reinstate = H.signal('reinstate');
const churn = H.signal('churn');

const accountManager = H.role('account-manager').intents('read').instructions('Summarize usage and the upsell case in plain language.');
const usageSummarizer = H.seat('usage-summarizer').role(accountManager).model(sonnet).pool(pool);
const usageReport = H.command('usage-report')
  .input(z.object({ customerId: z.string() }))
  .argv(i => ['./bin/usage', i.customerId])
  .runner(runner);
const upsell = H.halt('upsell').decision(z.object({ upsell: z.boolean(), note: z.string() }));

const tenancyFlow = H.flow('tenancy-review')
  .input(TenancyAttrs)
  .step('usage', usageReport, ctx => ({ customerId: ctx.unit.attributes.customerId }))
  .step('summary', usageSummarizer, ctx => ({ task: `Summarize this month for ${ctx.unit.attributes.customerId} on ${ctx.unit.attributes.plan}:\n${ctx.steps.usage.stdout}` }))
  .halt('upsell', upsell, { ask: ctx => `Upsell ${ctx.unit.attributes.customerId}?\n${ctx.steps.summary}` })
  .exit('reviewed');

const billingEvents = webhook.json('billing-events', {
  port: H.slot.port(1),
  path: '/billing',
  secret: H.env('BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET'),
  payload: z.object({ type: z.enum(['signup', 'suspend', 'reinstate', 'churn']), customerId: z.string(), plan: z.string() }),
});

const tenancyLane = H.lane('tenancies', Tenancy)
  .supply(billingEvents, (ev, to) =>
    ev.type === 'signup' ? to.create({ customerId: ev.customerId, plan: ev.plan })
      : ev.type === 'suspend' ? to.signal(suspend, ev.customerId, {})
        : ev.type === 'reinstate' ? to.signal(reinstate, ev.customerId, {})
          : to.signal(churn, ev.customerId, {}))
  .supply(H.operator)
  .handler(tenancyFlow, { exits: { reviewed: Customer } })
  .store(store)
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 3, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 3_600_000, exhausted: Customer })
  .on(reviewDue, { enter: ReviewDue })
  .on(suspend, { enter: Suspended })
  .on(reinstate, { enter: Customer })
  .on(churn, { enter: Churned });

const monthlyReview = H.trigger('monthly-tenancy-review')
  .on(H.when.timer(tenancyLane, {
    at: unit => unit.state === Customer ? H.nextTime('09:00', { after: unit.stateSince, on: 1 }) : undefined,
  }))
  .signal(reviewDue, tenancyLane, ev => ({ key: ev.unit.key, payload: {} }));

const NegotiationAttrs = z.object({
  negotiationId: z.string(),
  vendor: z.string(),
  item: z.string(),
  deadline: z.string(),
  history: z.array(z.string()),
});
const Drafting = H.state('Drafting', 'pending');
const AwaitingVendor = H.state('AwaitingVendor', 'waiting');
const Stalled = H.state('Stalled', 'waiting');
const Agreed = H.terminal('Agreed', 'success');
const WalkedAwayByUs = H.terminal('WalkedAwayByUs', 'neutral');
const WalkedAwayByThem = H.terminal('WalkedAwayByThem', 'failure');
const Expired = H.terminal('Expired', 'failure');
const Negotiation = H.kind('Negotiation')
  .attributes(NegotiationAttrs)
  .states(Drafting, AwaitingVendor, Stalled, Agreed, WalkedAwayByUs, WalkedAwayByThem, Expired)
  .key(a => a.negotiationId)
  .initial(Drafting);

const VendorMessage = z.object({ message: z.string() });
const vendorReplied = H.signal('vendor-replied').payload(VendorMessage);
const vendorAccepted = H.signal('vendor-accepted').payload(VendorMessage);
const vendorWalked = H.signal('vendor-walked').payload(VendorMessage);
const expire = H.signal('expire');
const nudge = H.signal('nudge');

const negotiator = H.role('negotiator').intents('read').instructions('Draft the next move toward an agreement within the mandate.');
const offerDrafter = H.seat('offer-drafter')
  .role(negotiator)
  .model(sonnet)
  .pool(pool)
  .output(z.object({ action: z.enum(['offer', 'accept', 'walkAway']), message: z.string() }));
const sendToVendor = H.command('send-to-vendor')
  .input(z.object({ negotiationId: z.string(), message: z.string() }))
  .argv(i => ['./bin/send-vendor', i.negotiationId, i.message])
  .runner(runner);

const roundFlow = H.flow('negotiation-round')
  .input(NegotiationAttrs)
  .step('draft', offerDrafter, ctx => ({
    task: `Negotiate ${ctx.unit.attributes.item} with ${ctx.unit.attributes.vendor}. Vendor messages so far:\n${ctx.unit.attributes.history.join('\n')}`,
  }))
  .step('send', sendToVendor, ctx => ({ negotiationId: ctx.unit.attributes.negotiationId, message: ctx.steps.draft.message }), { afterCrash: 'park' })
  .exit('accepted', ctx => ctx.steps.draft.action === 'accept')
  .exit('walkedAway', ctx => ctx.steps.draft.action === 'walkAway')
  .exit('offered');

const vendorWebhook = webhook.json('vendor-replies', {
  port: H.slot.port(2),
  path: '/vendor',
  secret: H.env('VENDOR_WEBHOOK_SECRET'),
  payload: z.object({ negotiationId: z.string(), status: z.enum(['counter', 'accept', 'walkAway']), message: z.string() }),
});

const negotiationLane = H.lane('negotiations', Negotiation)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .supply(vendorWebhook, (ev, to) =>
    ev.status === 'counter' ? to.signal(vendorReplied, ev.negotiationId, { message: ev.message })
      : ev.status === 'accept' ? to.signal(vendorAccepted, ev.negotiationId, { message: ev.message })
        : to.signal(vendorWalked, ev.negotiationId, { message: ev.message }))
  .handler(roundFlow, { exits: { accepted: Agreed, walkedAway: WalkedAwayByUs, offered: AwaitingVendor } })
  .store(store)
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 3, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 300_000, exhausted: Stalled })
  .on(vendorReplied, { update: (a, p) => ({ ...a, history: [...a.history, p.message] }), enter: Drafting })
  .on(vendorAccepted, { update: (a, p) => ({ ...a, history: [...a.history, p.message] }), enter: Agreed })
  .on(vendorWalked, { update: (a, p) => ({ ...a, history: [...a.history, p.message] }), enter: WalkedAwayByThem })
  .on(expire, { enter: Expired })
  .on(nudge, { enter: Drafting });

const negotiationExpiry = H.trigger('negotiation-expiry')
  .on(H.when.timer(negotiationLane, {
    at: unit => unit.position === 'terminal' ? undefined : new Date(unit.attributes.deadline),
  }))
  .signal(expire, negotiationLane, ev => ({ key: ev.unit.key, payload: {} }));

const operatorApi = http.controlApi('operator-api', {
  port: H.slot.port(3),
  token: H.env('OPERATOR_API_TOKEN'),
  grants: [H.ops.workRead, H.ops.workCreate, H.ops.workSignal, H.ops.workCancel, H.ops.resolve(upsell), H.ops.telemetryRead],
});

export const harness = H.harness('lifecycles')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: './lifecycles/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(experimentLane, tenancyLane, negotiationLane)
  .triggers(monthlyReview, negotiationExpiry)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('lifecycles')

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { folder } from 'harness-dsl/folder';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const store = sqlite.store({ path: './ml/store.sqlite' });
const runner = local.runner('ml-box');

const DatabaseName = z.enum(['orders', 'billing', 'features']);
const databases = {
  orders: H.resource('orders-db'),
  billing: H.resource('billing-db'),
  features: H.resource('features-db'),
};

const EvalAttrs = z.object({ runId: z.string(), checkpoint: z.string() });
const EvalRequested = H.state('EvalRequested', 'pending');
const Scored = H.terminal('Scored', 'success');
const EvalFailed = H.terminal('EvalFailed', 'failure');
const EvalRun = H.kind('EvalRun').attributes(EvalAttrs).states(EvalRequested, Scored, EvalFailed).key(a => a.runId).initial(EvalRequested);

const prepare = H.command('prepare-eval').input(EvalAttrs).argv(i => ['./bin/prepare', i.runId, i.checkpoint]).runner(runner);
const submitEval = H.command('submit-gpu-eval')
  .input(EvalAttrs)
  .argv(i => ['./bin/gpu', 'submit', i.runId, i.checkpoint])
  .output(z.object({ jobId: z.string() }))
  .runner(runner);
const collectEval = H.command('collect-gpu-eval')
  .input(z.object({ jobId: z.string() }))
  .argv(h => ['./bin/gpu', 'status', h.jobId])
  .output(H.jobPoll(z.object({ resultsPath: z.string() })))
  .runner(runner);
const gpuEval = H.job('gpu-eval', { submit: submitEval, collect: collectEval, pollEveryMinutes: 10 });
const score = H.command('score-eval')
  .input(z.object({ resultsPath: z.string() }))
  .argv(i => ['./bin/score', i.resultsPath])
  .output(z.object({ score: z.number(), report: z.string() }))
  .runner(runner);

const apiAccount = anthropic.account('ml-api', {
  apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'),
  quota: sqlite.quota('ml-api', { path: './ml/quota.sqlite' }),
});
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });
const analyst = H.role('eval-analyst').intents('read').instructions('Summarize the evaluation for the team.');
const summarizer = H.seat('eval-summarizer').role(analyst).model(sonnet).pool(H.pool('ml').accounts(apiAccount));

const evalFlow = H.flow('eval-run')
  .input(EvalAttrs)
  .step('prepare', prepare, ctx => ({ runId: ctx.unit.attributes.runId, checkpoint: ctx.unit.attributes.checkpoint }), { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .job('gpu', gpuEval, ctx => ({ runId: ctx.unit.attributes.runId, checkpoint: ctx.unit.attributes.checkpoint }))
  .step('score', score, ctx => ({ resultsPath: ctx.steps.gpu.resultsPath }), { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .step('summarize', summarizer, ctx => ({ task: `Summarize eval ${ctx.unit.attributes.runId}: score ${ctx.steps.score.score}\n${ctx.steps.score.report}` }))
  .exit('scored');

const evalLane = H.lane('evals', EvalRun)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .handler(evalFlow, { exits: { scored: Scored } })
  .store(store)
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 600_000, exhausted: EvalFailed });

const MigrationAttrs = z.object({ migrationId: z.string(), database: DatabaseName, path: z.string() });
const MigrationQueued = H.state('MigrationQueued', 'pending');
const MigrationHeld = H.state('MigrationHeld', 'waiting');
const Applied = H.terminal('Applied', 'success');
const MigrationFailed = H.terminal('MigrationFailed', 'failure');
const Migration = H.kind('Migration')
  .attributes(MigrationAttrs)
  .states(MigrationQueued, MigrationHeld, Applied, MigrationFailed)
  .key(a => a.migrationId)
  .initial(MigrationQueued);

const applyMigration = H.command('apply-migration')
  .input(MigrationAttrs)
  .argv(i => ['./bin/migrate', i.database, i.path])
  .runner(runner);

const migrationFlow = H.flow('migration')
  .input(MigrationAttrs)
  .step('apply', applyMigration, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes, { afterCrash: 'park' })
  .exit('applied');

const migrationLane = H.lane('migrations', Migration)
  .supply(folder.files({ path: './migrations', glob: '*.sql' }), (file, to) => {
    const [stem, database] = file.name.split('.');
    const parsed = DatabaseName.safeParse(database);
    return parsed.success
      ? to.create({ migrationId: stem.slice(0, 4), database: parsed.data, path: file.path })
      : to.skip();
  })
  .handler(migrationFlow, { exits: { applied: Applied } })
  .store(store)
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 1, exhausted: MigrationFailed })
  .lease(unit => ({ resource: databases[unit.attributes.database], mode: 'exclusive' }))
  .after({
    key: attrs => {
      const number = Number(attrs.migrationId);
      return number > 1 ? String(number - 1).padStart(4, '0') : undefined;
    },
    onPredecessorFailed: MigrationHeld,
  });

const batchRows = 10_000;
const BackfillAttrs = z.object({ table: z.string(), database: DatabaseName, totalRows: z.number() });
const BackfillQueued = H.state('BackfillQueued', 'pending');
const Backfilled = H.terminal('Backfilled', 'success');
const BackfillFailed = H.terminal('BackfillFailed', 'failure');
const Backfill = H.kind('Backfill')
  .attributes(BackfillAttrs)
  .states(BackfillQueued, Backfilled, BackfillFailed)
  .key(a => `${a.database}.${a.table}`)
  .initial(BackfillQueued);

const backfillBatch = H.command('backfill-batch')
  .input(z.object({ database: DatabaseName, table: z.string(), offset: z.number(), limit: z.number() }))
  .argv(i => ['./bin/backfill', i.database, i.table, String(i.offset), String(i.limit)])
  .runner(runner);

const backfillFlow = H.flow('backfill')
  .input(BackfillAttrs)
  .loop('batches', f => f
    .step('batch', backfillBatch, ctx => ({
      database: ctx.unit.attributes.database,
      table: ctx.unit.attributes.table,
      offset: ctx.iteration * batchRows,
      limit: batchRows,
    }), { afterCrash: 'rerun', retry: { maxAttempts: 3, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 30_000 } }),
    { max: ctx => Math.ceil(ctx.unit.attributes.totalRows / batchRows) })
  .exit('backfilled');

const backfillLane = H.lane('backfills', Backfill)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .handler(backfillFlow, { exits: { backfilled: Backfilled } })
  .store(store)
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, exhausted: BackfillFailed })
  .lease(unit => ({ resource: databases[unit.attributes.database], mode: 'shared' }));

const supervisor = claudeCode.supervisor('ml-supervisor', {
  port: H.slot.port(1),
  grants: [H.ops.workRead, H.ops.workCreate, H.ops.workCancel, H.ops.attemptsRecover, H.ops.telemetryRead],
});

export const harness = H.harness('ml-platform')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: './ml/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(migrationLane, backfillLane, evalLane)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('ml-platform')
    .standard(migrationLane, backfillLane, evalLane)
    .wip(evalLane, 2)
    .admit(evalLane, ctx => {
      const gpu = ctx.metrics.jobs({ job: gpuEval, window: { calendar: 'day' } });
      return gpu.samples < 5 || gpu.hoursInFlight < 40;
    })
    .admit(backfillLane, ctx => {
      const waits = ctx.metrics.leases({ resource: databases[ctx.unit.attributes.database], window: { lastHours: 24 } });
      return waits.samples < 10 || waits.medianWaitMs < 30 * 60_000;
    }))
  .clients(supervisor)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: './ml/BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: './ml/TELEMETRY.md' }));

=== END ===
